{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2009}}
{{main|2009 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2009 World Table Tennis Championships women's doubles''' was the 49th edition of the women's doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Tennis}}</ref><ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-04-12|title=Women's doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref>
[[Li Xiaoxia]] and [[Guo Yue (table tennis)|Guo Yue]] defeated [[Ding Ning]] and [[Guo Yan]] in the final by four sets to one.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123|access-date=2018-03-21|archive-date=2018-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922055935/http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
